statement: ∀ a1 a2, D (a1 + a2) = D a1 + D a2) [AddLeftStrictMono B] [AddRightStrictMono B] (hD : D.Injective) {ap aq : A} (hp : p.supDegree D ≤ D ap) (hq : q.supDegree D ≤ D aq) : (p * q) (ap + aq) = p ap * q aq
